'''Pintu Son-El''' was a [[Moyn]] [[Gender|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He was a [[Currency|moneylender]] and would often use rough tactics to get his payments back.

==Biography==
[[File:Pintu_arrives.png|left|thumb|317x317px|Son-El entered Trace's repair shop to collect his money.]]
By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes the [[trial of Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Order 66]] both occurred in [[19 BBY]]. As "[[Gone with a Trace]]" takes place between these events, the events of the episode must occur in 19 BBY.</ref> Pintu had lent [[Currency|money]] to [[Rafa Martez]]. The young [[Gender|woman]] had failed to pay back the sum on [[time]] however, so Pintu took two of his [[Pintu's henchmen|henchmen]] and headed to the [[Martez sisters' repair shop|repair shop]] of her sister, [[Trace Martez]]. Pintu demanded to know where his money was when he entered the shop. The surprised Trace tried to make excuses. Pintu saw through her bluff and set his henchmen on her and a fight broke out. Trace was almost beaten senseless when [[Ahsoka Tano]] joined the fight and easily defeated the henchmen. Pintu was surprised and ran with his men out of the shop, while reminding Martez that her sister's debts were far from being paid. Rafa later paid off her debt to Son-El with [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] she had gotten from the [[Twi'lek]] [[Lokann]] for building some [[binary loadlifter]] [[droid]]s.<ref name="Gone with a Trace" />

==Personality and traits==
Son-El was a 1.88 [[meter]] (6 [[Foot|feet]], 2 inches) tall [[Moyn]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="TCWE" /> with brown [[hair]], black [[eye]]s and brown skin.<ref name="Gone with a Trace" /> He was a petty criminal who dwelled in Coruscant's lower levels, scraping by lending credits and striking dirty deals. After Rafa Martez failed to pay him back as quickly as he desired, he resorted to intimidation,<ref name="TCWE" /> bringing his thugs with him to Trace Martez's repair shop, in an attempt to forcibly get his credits from the sisters.<ref name="Gone with a Trace" />

==Skills and abilities==
Son-El liked to negotiate and even persuade others to think his way.<ref name="TCWE" /> When they did not, he resorted to hand-to-hand combat and forcibly sent his henchmen to accomplish his mission, such as receiving the payment Rafa Martez owed him. However, Ahsoka Tano intervened, overpowering Son-El and his thugs, forcing them to flee.<ref name="Gone with a Trace" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Okami! Do you have what you owe me?!|Pintu yelling at Nyx Okami|<ref name="Ahsoka's Untold Tales">{{SWYouTube|lS4sclln5J4|Ahsoka's Untold Tales Panel | Star Wars Celebration Europe 2016}}</ref>}}
[[File:Yushyn_original_concept.png|thumb|right|150px|Pintu's design was based on concept art drawn by Ralph McQuarrie.]]
Prior to the cancellation of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series, Pintu was to appear in an episode starring Ahsoka Tano. He was first revealed at the "Ahsoka's Untold Tales" panel at [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration Europe]] in 2016, where a clip was shown where he confronted [[Nyx Okami]] for money that he had lent.<ref name="Ahsoka's Untold Tales" /> The character's design was based on a piece of [[alien]] [[bounty hunter]] concept art drawn by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="TCEG">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-call-episode-guide|text="The Call" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> which was realized in [[2016]] when [[Yushyn]], who was of the same species, was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[The Call]]."<ref name="The Call">{{Rebels|The Call}}</ref> Pintu later appeared in the [[2020]] episode "[[Gone with a Trace]]," voiced by [[Bobby Moynihan]], where the Martez sisters took Okami's place in the completed storyline.<ref name="Gone with a Trace" />
